name: Cuban solidarity silkscreen poster
summary: A poster in flat colour and a bold shape. ICAIC printed film posters by hand-pulled silkscreen in short runs. OSPAAAL printed solidarity posters by offset and folded them into the Tricontinental magazine.

philosophy.core_thesis: Two to four flat inks and one strong shape can carry a political or film message to a street in any language.
design_principles: Reduce the image to one bold shape or one cut-out figure that a viewer reads in two seconds.
Use 2–5 flat opaque inks; red, black and yellow are the main set.
Take the figure from a photograph, then cut it to flat shapes with no tone.
Cut the stencil by hand and keep its slightly rough edge.
Leave a large field of one colour for the message.
Keep the text short, in a bold hand-drawn or geometric letter.
Allow a gap or an overlap of 1–2 mm where two inks meet.
anti_patterns: A smooth gradient or a halftone photograph
A crowded layout of small text and ornament
A thin, fine line that the mesh cannot hold

process.matrix: A silk mesh screen with a hand-cut or photographic stencil. OSPAAAL also used offset plates.
process.press: A hand squeegee table for ICAIC; an offset press for OSPAAAL.
process.image_making: The designer makes a collage and cuts a stencil for each colour, or exposes a photographic stencil.
process.edition: Hundreds of sheets for a screen-printed film poster; many thousands for an offset solidarity poster.

inks.strategy: A tight set of flat, opaque inks, one stencil for each, with the paper as the light.

screening.rule: Print every area as a flat solid; show a mid-tone only as a cut-out shape or as a coarse hatch, never as a screen.

registration.rule: Overlap neighbouring inks by 0.5 mm; a shift of 1 mm between hand-pulled colours is normal.

substrate.stock: An uncoated offset or poster paper, light in weight, off-white.
substrate.finish: Uncoated and matt, with a slight tooth.

surface.impression: No bite; the screen ink lies as a thin layer on the surface.
surface.sheen: Matt to satin, with a flat, even colour.
surface.texture: Flat fields with a small mesh texture and hand-cut edges.

emotion.target_response: Urgency and pride: the viewer feels a clear call in a few loud colours.

avoid_when: The message needs fine detail or a long text.
The brand needs a quiet or luxury tone.

modifiers.how: Swap the red and black set for fluorescent inks and add hand-drawn outlined letters.
Add a coarse halftone photo layer and let the colour shift by 2–4 mm.
